building_envelope.caveat: the OUTER face of the external wall ring bounds this, so the envelope includes the external wall's own thickness. Free space is measured after that wall is subtracted, so a room is unaffected — but the envelope area is not a floor area
evidence: 3 ring component(s) holding 111.458 m2 of material and enclosing 1000.096 m2 — a best enclosure ratio of 38.7, which is what a ring of external wall looks like. 28 component(s) outside were NOT filled

internal_barrier_sensitivity.how_external_was_decided: a barrier lying within 1.0 mm of the envelope's own boundary closes an external opening. Membership of the wall solid's ring COMPONENT is not the test: that component carries almost every band, because internal walls touching the external ring are part of the same connected solid
internal_barrier_sensitivity.the_test: ALL vs EXTERNAL must agree to within an absolute tolerance. NONE is context and is expected to differ, because an external ring with an unclosed doorway is a C-shape rather than a ring
internal_barrier_sensitivity.why_it_matters: a barrier inside the building cannot add or remove floor. If removing the internal ones moves the envelope, the envelope is being derived from internal geometry and every area measured against it is wrong by an amount nobody can see

falsifiers.interpretation: CONCLUSION: the engine is enumerating CYCLES OF THE ABSTRACT GRAPH and calling them faces. two bounded regions share positive area, so they are NOT faces of a planar subdivision — faces are connected components of the plane minus the graph, and components are disjoint by definition Also: at least one node has two outgoing half-edges at the same angle, so the rotation system is ILL-DEFINED there: the angular sort between them is arbitrary and `next` may splice two faces into one walk or split one face across two Also: at least one edge pair crosses with no vertex at the crossing, so the drawing is not a planar embedding at all and walks pass THROUGH each other Also: some half-edge is used by no walk or by more than one, which a true face traversal cannot do Also: the face count is inconsistent with V - E + F = 1 + C Also: signed walk areas do not cancel within a component, which they must when every edge is traversed once in each direction

ENCLOSURE_FREEZE.what_this_does_not_prove: anything about a real drawing. These rooms were built to have known answers, which is what makes them safe to set thresholds on and useless as evidence of field accuracy
ENCLOSURE_FREEZE.what_this_proves: the enclosure returns the area each room was BUILT with, while the traced raster contour of the same room does not. The contour is wrong by a measured amount on most fixtures because it follows baths, wardrobes, nosings and door leaves; the enclosure never sees them, because a fixture is not a boundary candidate

C_topology_recall.threshold: at least double the deterministic figure

GATE.what_failure_would_mean: the next product decision becomes PDF support with human-assisted boundary confirmation, rather than continuing to invent automation
GATE.what_neither_means: a condition was met on finding rooms and not on measuring them, or the boundaries matched substantially but did not close. That is progress with a named blocker, and it is neither the success the round asked for nor the failure it defined

COLLINEAR_JOIN_MM.why: two collinear pieces closer than this are one line interrupted by plotting noise. Two orders of magnitude above the measured coordinate-noise floor and above the 0.05 mm snap grid

JUNCTION_REACH_MM.why: the only tolerance that can CLOSE anything, so it is deliberately tight: a hairline plotting gap at a junction, never a missing wall or a doorway

MIN_CELL_MM.why: below this an arrangement cell is a sliver

MIN_ENCLOSURE_M2.why: below this a filled area is not a space

NEIGHBOURHOOD_MARGIN_MM.why: a room's wall lies outside its free-space region by at most the wall's thickness. 1 m covers any wall a drawing of this kind carries, with room to spare

frozen_parameters.how_these_were_set: from geometry and from the drawing medium's measured noise floor, on synthetic fixtures, BEFORE any real drawing was evaluated. None may be changed because a real drawing scores better unless the same change is justified synthetically

LOCAL_SPACE_ENCLOSURES.what_a_fixture_does_here: nothing. A bathtub, a cabinet or a stair nosing is not a boundary candidate, so it cannot block a cell edge and cannot indent a result. There is no detour test because a detour cannot arise
LOCAL_SPACE_ENCLOSURES.what_the_raster_supplied: an interior point and an approximate extent. Not one millimetre of any boundary

notes.basis: IoU here is the ratio of the smaller area to the larger, between the vector polygon and the raster mask's approximate area. It is an agreement indicator between two different kinds of object, not an accuracy figure against ground truth

MEASUREMENT_SCORE_can_it_measure_the_roo.this_is_not_topology_recall: every figure here is about regions that were already found. How many rooms the system finds is §16's question

vector_vs_raster.perimeter_is_not_compared_to_the_mask: a pixel mask's perimeter is a staircase — measured at 4.7x the equivalent square on this project — so comparing perimeters would report the raster's raggedness as the engine's error
vector_vs_raster.what_the_raster_is_here: COMPARISON DATA, not released geometry. A difference between the vector polygon and the pixel mask does not say which is right: the mask is a ragged approximation and the polygon is built from drawn lines

the_two_axes.why_both: a wall measured twice off one polyline is one observation wearing two hats. A gap, a swing arc and a printed width are three things a draughtsman drew separately, which is why their agreement is informative even on one sheet

evidence.what_this_does_not_do: lower any geometric standard. Exact coordinates still come from source geometry, never from a model reading a picture
evidence.why: 2 differently authored channels on one drawing (DRAWN_GEOMETRY, DRAWN_SYMBOL). They could have disagreed, and they do not

rows.geometric_standard_unchanged: the opening's coordinates come from the drawn jamb geometry. The evidence tier decides whether the opening is THERE, never where it is
rows.why: SAME_DRAWING_ORTHOGONAL: 2 differently authored channels on one drawing (DRAWN_GEOMETRY, DRAWN_SYMBOL). They could have disagreed, and they do not. PORTAL_EVIDENCE_GRADES.what_changed_from_round_2: requiring two SOURCE INDEPENDENCE classes meant no doorway on a single architectural sheet could ever be validated, which is not how a professional takeoff works. The requirement is now two differently AUTHORED channels — a gap, a swing arc, a printed width — with independence recorded separately and still required for the openings where a wrong call is expensive
PORTAL_EVIDENCE_GRADES.what_did_not_change: exact opening coordinates come from drawn geometry. No tier lets a model's reading supply a millimetre

ROOM_CANDIDATE_PRECISION.basis: among the regions that turned out to hold a labelled space, how many hold exactly one. This is the precision of the ROOM CANDIDATES

UNCLASSIFIED_REGION_COUNT.what_these_are: wall cavities, areas outside the building, fixture gaps and other components of the render's free space
UNCLASSIFIED_REGION_COUNT.why_not_a_precision_penalty: they were never claimed to be rooms. Classification comes AFTER segmentation, so an unclassified region is unclassified — not a false-positive room

denominators.why_both: every labelled space on the sheet, and the subset the job is scoped to. A recall against one is not comparable with a recall against the other, so both are printed

ROUND_3_DECISION.what_the_second_means: automatic topology, plus human confirmation of the boundary runs the drawing does not support, plus deterministic vector measurement. A legitimate product architecture, and the one the round names if high topology recall still yields essentially no complete measured spaces

labelled_space_partition_status.basis: the weakest frontier a space has. A space whose every frontier is material or a validated portal is RELEASABLE; one frontier resting on an unvalidated portal makes it DIAGNOSTIC; a frontier with neither makes it UNRESOLVED

notes.how_the_partition_was_decided: wall material where the frontier carries no candidate opening, and a graded PORTAL_PARTITION_BOUNDARY where it does. The render's ink located the frontier and decided nothing about it

THREE_TOPOLOGY_MODEL.the_conflation_this_prevents: one binary portal operation cannot serve three questions. A bedroom and its ensuite are one opening, two rooms and one navigable connection at the same time, and a system that holds only one of those keeps trading it for another

what_each_model_is_for.NAVIGABLE_FREE_SPACE: circulation and connectivity, if and when they are needed. A doorway is PASSABLE here. This model may NEVER define room identity
what_each_model_is_for.ROOM_PARTITION_TOPOLOGY: room polygons, floor areas, room identity, bedroom vs bathroom. A doorway CLOSES the room boundary virtually, still with zero material

what_establishes_each_relation.ONE_PHYSICAL_SPACE: explicit open-plan evidence: a schedule or note declaring one space, a single label spanning the whole extent, or a continuous finish boundary with no separator drawn anywhere on the frontier
what_establishes_each_relation.ROOM_PARTITION_RELATION_UNRESOLVED: nothing establishes UNRESOLVED — it is what remains when neither of the other two is established, and it may not decay into either
what_establishes_each_relation.TWO_DISTINCT_PHYSICAL_SPACES: supported separator evidence: continuous wall material, or a PORTAL_PARTITION_BOUNDARY backed by a graded portal

THREE_TOPOLOGY_MODEL.why_door_ink_is_not_a_boundary: a leaf, a swing arc or a threshold is EVIDENCE that a portal exists. None of them may become the room's boundary because rasterising the sheet turned its ink into a barrier: one architect hatches thresholds and another does not, so a room topology resting on that does not travel between architects

notes.how_the_human_answer_entered: only as which expected space positions fall inside which automatic region, and only after the automatic output hash was taken. Nothing human was available while the regions were being built

over_segmentation.what_it_means: one physical space came back as several regions. A wall was seen that is not there, or a fitting cut the room

TOPOLOGY_SCORE_can_it_find_the_room.precision_basis: automatic regions holding exactly one expected space, over all automatic regions
TOPOLOGY_SCORE_can_it_find_the_room.recall_basis: expected spaces found as EXACTLY ONE region, over all expected spaces. A space split in two is not found
TOPOLOGY_SCORE_can_it_find_the_room.this_is_not_measurement_accuracy: finding a room and measuring it are different questions with different evidence. No figure here says anything about millimetres

under_segmentation.what_it_means: several physical spaces came back as one region. A separator was missed, or the opening between them is genuinely open

boundary_matching.polygon_rule: built from the chosen vector objects only. A run with no match stays UNRESOLVED and leaves the candidate PARTIAL — it does not fall back to the pixel coordinate, and the raster outline is never scaled, warped, offset or smoothed into place
boundary_matching.selection_rule: LOCAL and PRIORITY-LED. A candidate must be on the run's own axis, within the search window, and share enough extent to be the same wall; among those the higher authority source wins even when a lower one is nearer. NOT global-nearest: the nearest line to a room's north wall can be the south face of the wall above it

notes.what_is_compared: the room's CLEAR EXTENT between opposite matched faces, against the dimensions printed on that room. document_dimension_vs_vector.tolerance_basis: the printed values on this sheet are rounded to the nearest 50 mm, the vector faces are measured to ~0.01 mm, and a finish-face convention can legitimately differ by a plaster coat. Set from the instruments, not from what makes more rows agree
document_dimension_vs_vector.what_this_is_for: asking the document and the geometry the same question about SIZE and reporting whether they agree. It is a much stronger use of a document reading than letting it measure
document_dimension_vs_vector.what_this_may_never_do: average the two, or lift a room's identity. A printed 3.50 matching a measured 3497 proves the SIZE is right and says nothing about WHICH ROOM it is

enclosure_synthetic_outcomes.note: the wardrobe and the bed touch the walls, so the raster contour steps around both. Neither is a boundary
three sanitary fittings against three different walls. The clear internal area is the room, not the room minus the bath
the clear internal boundary crosses the opening on the jamb line. Without the portal the room is not enclosed
an opening nobody has validated is a hole in the boundary. The space is PARTIAL, not 7.5 m²
six sides, and the inner corner is a real feature not a jog
a 100 mm partition and a 440 mm external wall bound the same room. Thickness changes nothing about the clear area
the window's sill and frame lines sit inside the room's north face. The face is continuous, so the room closes
two labels do not make two rooms. The free-standing column is material inside one space: it is DEDUCTED as a hole, not treated as a boundary and not ignored
a shaft encloses perfectly well. Whether it is a WASHROOM is an identity question this stage never asks
the south wall was never drawn. A rectangle would be convenient and is not evidence, so the answer is PARTIAL
nine nosing lines cross the whole region, cutting the raster mask into ten strips. None of them is a wall
a 1.5 mm hairline at the junction is plotting noise. Both faces exist as drawing geometry and their extents reach the junction, so the corner is constructed, not invented
50 mm is not plotting noise, it is a gap. Closing it would be extending a wall until it hit another line
the north and south faces both run past where the east wall would be. Two parallel lines do not make a corner, and nothing supported closes the east side

notes.order: the automatic topology was hashed before any label, golden region or benchmark was read. Labels enter only as identity evidence and as the §16 score's input

A_TOPOLOGY_REGIONS.answers: is there one connected physical space here

B_MEASURED_SPACE_CANDIDATES.answers: can this region's boundary be measured from source geometry, interval by interval

C_RELEASED_PHYSICAL_SPACES.answers: may a quantity be built on this polygon

objects.these_counts_are_not_comparable: a region is not a partly-released space. Reading the three numbers as one funnel of the same object is the error the separation exists to prevent
objects.why_three_objects: they have different evidence, different failure modes and different release rules. Collapsing them is how a raster blob became an area: a region is a topology claim, a candidate is a measurement, and only the third is a quantity

roles.a_label_is_not_evidence_of_role: every role above was decided without reading a name. Labels are recorded beside the verdict so a human can see disagreement — which is how the WSH-01 error was found, and how it stays found
roles.why_adjacency_does_not_decide_a_role: connecting three or more regions is recorded and does not make a space circulation: a bedroom beside a bathroom, a corridor and a dressing room connects three too. Function is a zone question, not a physical property

search_window_sensitivity.why_not_wider: a wider window starts matching the far face of the same wall, or the near face of the next room's wall. Both close the polygon and both measure the wrong room

grid_actually_used.why: a grid smaller than the noise floor leaves coincident nodes unmerged, which shows up as spurious components in the wall solid. A grid larger than the noise floor is safe only while it stays below the nearest thing anybody drew, and the measured empty band is what establishes that

numerical_snap_tolerance.not_a_drawing_constant: this is a measurement of THIS drawing's coordinates. It is recorded per run and must not be promoted to a project or engine default: the next sheet is produced by different software with different precision
numerical_snap_tolerance.snapping_is_not_gap_closing: the recommendation sits at the representation-noise floor. A gap larger than that is two walls that do not meet, and closing it would invent material
numerical_snap_tolerance.why: 235 vertex pairs from different rings lie within 1.0 mm of each other. The largest of them is 0.00869592 mm, the population reaches <=0.01 mm, and every decade from <=0.1 mm up to the 1.0 mm ceiling is EMPTY — a clear band with nothing in it. So representation noise on this drawing ends at <=0.01 mm and the nearest thing anybody drew is at least 0.1 mm away. The grid goes at 0.01 mm: large enough to merge the coincident nodes, orders of magnitude too small to close anything drawn
numerical_snap_tolerance.why_the_measured_grid_for_production: topology, not area, decides whether a tolerance is safe. A microscopic change can still create a connection, so the established solid is built on the measured noise floor and physical junctions are closed by an explicit JUNCTION_PATCH
